description: This file contains styles for a Tic Tac Toe game application, including layout and theming variables.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the Tic Tac Toe application, centers all components.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Style for the game title, defines font size and color.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Container for the game components, arranges them in a column.

classes.name: scoreboard
classes.description: Style for the scoreboard section, lays out score cards.

classes.name: score-card
classes.description: Individual score card style within the scoreboard.

classes.name: board
classes.description: Defines grid layout for the Tic Tac Toe playing field.

classes.name: cell
classes.description: Style for each cell in the Tic Tac Toe board, including hover effects.

classes.name: controls
classes.description: Container for control buttons, displayed below the game board.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Base style for all buttons in the application.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Displays the current game status or message to the user.
